evidence_refs.quote: The agents find a target company’s customers and industry experts, interview them in their own languages, and compare the answers with published research and the fund’s own data.

LATO’s agents find customers and industry experts, then interview them in their own languages. The platform analyses the conversations alongside public information and a fund’s internal data, giving investment teams one view of a market.

investment_rationale.speaker: Nathan Benaich
investment_rationale.rationale: 投资决策依赖理解客户为何购买以及产品为何特别，投资者需要在数小时而非数周内获得一手证据；LATO 的智能体直接从客户和专家处收集证据，并保留原始访谈供投资者核查。
investment_rationale.quote: Investment decisions depend on understanding why customers buy and what makes a product truly special. In an extremely competitive market, investors need to acquire this information in days if not hours. LATO deploys agents to gather that evidence directly from customers and experts, while giving investors the underlying interviews to examine for themselves.

evidence_refs.quote: “Investment decisions depend on understanding why customers buy and what makes a product truly special. In an extremely competitive market, investors need to acquire this information in days if not hours. LATO deploys agents to gather that evidence directly from customers and experts, while giving investors the underlying interviews to examine for themselves.

investment_rationale.speaker: Borys Musielak
investment_rationale.rationale: LATO 的智能体能够寻找并访谈专家与客户，将研究过程压缩到数天，并提供可追溯到访谈原文的完整透明度，这使其区别于其他研究类初创公司。
investment_rationale.quote: When I heard that LATO’s agents could run the whole process, I knew this was something different. That means sourcing the right experts and customers, interviewing them in any language, and turning it into a report in days rather than weeks. And instead of just a PowerPoint, you get full transparency into what was said. Every finding traces back to the moment in the transcript, and you can listen to the answer yourself. That set LATO apart from all the other research startups I’d met and passed on before.

analysis.capital_judgment: 本轮资本押注的核心变量是：AI 智能体能否把私募股权商业尽调中的客户与专家访谈从数周压缩到数天，并以可回溯的一手访谈形成差异化研究交付。当前融资所依赖的已验证信号包括：公司自述在首项研究后约 100 天内年化收入运行率超过 100 万美元、完成 1,000 多次专家访谈、覆盖 35 个以上国家，并已服务 Verdane、Blume Equity、North Island 等基金客户。证据边界在于：收入运行率、访谈数量与客户资产规模均为公司自述，来源未披露合同金额、续费率或经审计财务数据；访谈覆盖国家数在不同来源分别写作 35+ 与 40+，存在口径差异。
